name: SAO TOME

flag.title: Green, Yellow, Red
flag.note: Black star on yellow centre stripe

lead: Two volcanic islands sit on the equator in the Gulf of Guinea. They were once the world's biggest chocolate makers. Rare birds hide in the rainforest. The whole country covers only 1,001 km².

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Two volcanoes rise from the Atlantic seabed to form the islands. They sit almost exactly on the equator. Thick rainforest cloaks the slopes.
Pico Cão Grande is a 300-metre needle of volcanic rock. It spears out of the jungle like a giant tooth. On tiny Ilhéu das Rolas, you can stand in two hemispheres.
animals: São Tomé and Príncipe has more endemic birds per km² than almost anywhere. Endemic means found nowhere else.
Sea turtles nest on the beaches. All native frogs live nowhere else on Earth. The São Tomé grosbeak, a giant finch, was rediscovered in 1991.
culture: People dance to puxa, a joyful music style. The air smells of roasting cacao. Calulu is a slow-cooked stew of smoked fish and palm oil.
Old plantation estates called roças dot the countryside. In 2024, the UN's FAO named the cacao forest farms a Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System.
history: Portuguese sailors found the empty islands around 1470. Within decades, São Tomé was the world's busiest sugar producer. Enslaved Africans did the work.
Independence came peacefully on 12 July 1975. In 1990, São Tomé became one of Africa's first democracies with many parties. Free elections followed in 1991.
wows: It was once the world's top cacao producer, yet it is smaller than London.
It has more endemic birds per km² than even the Galápagos Islands.
Pico Cão Grande rises 300 m above the jungle, as tall as the Eiffel Tower.
The equator crosses tiny Ilhéu das Rolas. One stride takes you from north to south.
Every native frog on São Tomé Island is found nowhere else on Earth.
Dobra banknotes show butterflies, not politicians or monuments.
The São Tomé grosbeak is the biggest canary-family bird. Scientists found it again in 1991.

myths.myth: Cacao beans taste like chocolate when picked
myths.fact: Fresh beans are bitter. They must be fermented, dried and roasted first. The white pulp around them tastes sweet and fruity.

myths.myth: Pico Cão Grande is a volcano that can erupt
myths.fact: It is a plug of hardened lava. Wind and rain wore away the softer rock around it.
